last.verdict: Better-than-guided quarter, a raised full-year outlook and a firmer 2027 view sent shares sharply higher.

reasons.label: Beat own forecast
reasons.text: Adjusted profit was $1.12 a share, well above the company's own $0.90 forecast.

reasons.label: Full-year outlook raised
reasons.text: 2026 profit forecast lifted to about $1.70 a share, after three straight cuts.

reasons.label: 2027 pricing recovery
reasons.text: Ticket prices expected to rise 1-2% in 2027, speeding up in the second half.

story: Norwegian cut its full-year profit forecast at each of its last three reports, from $2.38 a share to about $1.50. Weaker demand and higher fuel costs hurt, and the stock fell about 6% premarket in July despite a beat. This is the first raise.
